code_state_strings.decompile_integrity: The earlier NoteLong_{0} mismatch was caused by treating Ghidra StringLiteral_N labels as zero-based JSON indexes. The local Ghidra import script labels ScriptString entries starting at 1, while stringliteral.json and script.json arrays are zero-based. Therefore PTR_StringLiteral_9647 resolves to stringliteral.json[9646] / ScriptString[9646], which is NoteLaneEffectAnimationIdle. The raw global-metadata.dat string-literal table also has a different index space, so raw metadata index 9647 is not the same thing as Ghidra StringLiteral_9647.
